detail.longDescription: Just talked to Claude and couldn't believe how bad it was. Openly condescending! I used to prefer Claude because it was the most human-like (living up to the company name), but switched away a few months ago when they installed the "contemptuous British government official" personality. ChatGPT still has the classic ChatGPT smell, but they've at least stayed very consistent with it (excepting GPT-5, of course). On a more fundamental note, is anyone working with base/text models these days? I just saw that OpenAI's Davinci finally got retired a few weeks ago. Most of the OSS ones I found had synthetic cringe injected into the pretraining, so they weren't any good. I don't think this is something you can prompt around -- at least in my experience, models disregard style prompts after the first turn... Thoughts? Experiences? Would love to hear. Thanks
